It requires careful implementation of a multi-step analytical model (triangular loop strain tensor, projection onto [111], radial profile extraction), which goes beyond a simple library call but is not a novel research-grade algorithm. Understanding the domain (dislocation theory, tensor calculus) is needed.

All steps use standard Python libraries (numpy) and produce simple CSV files. No heavy environment setup, multi-tool orchestration, or fragile handoffs are required.
